skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge of traditional economic theory vs behavioral economics to analyze irrational behavior in economy.
Analyze and apply prospect theory compared to expected utility theory, especially in financial decision-making.
Analyze decision-making influenced by biases and apply theories to improve decision outcomes.
Evaluate the impact of emotions on decision-making and apply emotional theories to decision-making processes.
Assess differences between standard game theory and its extensions in behavioral economics, applying practical strategies in economic decisions.
